title: MLS Best-Selling Jerseys of 2025
scope: Player jersey sales during the 2025 MLS regular season, as announced by Major League Soccer in its season review.
methodology: MLS published the top 10 without naming the retailers included or publishing unit counts.
limitations: Replaced as the latest MLS list by the 2026 list MLS published on Nov. 3, 2026. The 2026 list covers MLS Store sales from January 1 to October 30, a different period and retailer scope, so the two are not compared rank by rank.
MLS announced the list in its 2025 regular-season review on Oct. 23, 2025 and did not name the retailers covered.
An earlier MLS list (June 18, 2025) covered only January 1 to May 1, 2025 on MLSstore.com, so the two are not compared.
